title: Copper Era
description: This mod adds many new copper-related items which improves the overall gameplay!
body:
# Copper Era

## This mod introduces various useful items to the game!

#### Steam-Powered Firework Rocket
- Works like a normal Firework Rocket
- Has a shorter flight duration
- Limited usage (64) but unbreakable
- Rechargeable

#### Steam-Powered Pearl
- Works like a normal Ender Pearl
- Heavier than a normal pearl
- Limited usage (16) but unbreakable
- Rechargeable

#### Steam-Infused Totem
- Works like a normal Totem of Undying
- Has 1 use but unbreakable
- Rechargeable

#### Steam Engine
- Used for recharging rechargeables
- Block of Coal is used as a fuel
- Water (Bucket) is used as medium
- 3 rechargeables can be recharged at once

#### Artificial Wind Charge
- Works like a normal Wind Charge
- Limited durability (64) and breakable
- Not rechargeable

#### Copper Flask
- Used for storing multiple potion effects (Similar to a bundle)
- Cannot store the same type of effect
- Can hold a maximum of 3 different effects
- Can be consumed instantly
- Unbreakable


### Crafting Recipes

- Steam-Powered Firework Rocket: x4 Waxed Oxidized Copper, x4 Copper Ingot, x1 Firework Rocket
  
- Steam-Powered Pearl: x6 Waxed Copper Grate, x2 Waxed Oxidized Copper, x1 Ender Pearl
  
- Steam-Infused Totem: x2 Waxed Copper Block, x2 Waxed Oxidized Copper, x1 Diamond Block, x1 Redstone Block, x1 Totem of Undying

- Steam Engine: x4 Waxed Copper Block, x4 Smooth Stone, x1 Redstone Block

- Artificial Wind Charge: x4 Copper Block, x4 Iron Ingot, x1 Wind Charge

- Copper Flask: x5 Waxed Copper Grate, x3 Waxed Cut Copper Slab, x1 Glass Bottle
